tracks.name: Percussion

tracks.name: Bass

tracks.name: Acid line
tracks.code: mask "<f!8 t!8>" $ n "a3 a3 c4 a3 ~ a4 g3 a3 a3 ~ e4 a3 c4 ~ a3 g4" # s "sawtooth" # lpf (range 300 3000 $ slow 16 sine) # resonance 0.25 # legato 0.6 # gain 0.55
